response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, particularly with JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, but his resume lacks direct experience with Java, Kotlin, or JVM tooling, which are core requirements for this role. While he has worked on diverse projects, none explicitly align with enterprise Java/Kotlin IDE development or deep JVM internals. His background in Node.js, web frameworks, and embedded systems does not directly translate to the required expertise.
strengths: Strong background in software craftsmanship and clean code practices
Experience with build tools and CI/CD pipelines
Proven track record of contributing to open-source projects
concerns: No direct experience with Java/Kotlin or JVM tooling
Lack of demonstrated work on IDE internals or language tooling
Primary expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, not aligned with enterprise Java frameworks
